title: Saving a case report form page

sections.heading: Form page will not save
sections.text: A case report form page cannot be saved while any required field is empty or contains a value in the wrong format. Fields that block saving are outlined in red and listed in the validation panel at the top of the page.

steps.text: Ask the user to open the validation panel at the top of the form page and review each listed field.
Ask the user to complete or correct each field outlined in red, using the format shown under the field label.
Ask the user to select Save again after the listed fields are corrected.

information_needed.prompt: Name of the form page and visit as shown in the page header.
The exact error message shown, copied without any subject or patient details.

stop_conditions.text: If saved values appear on a different subject's form, stop immediately and escalate as a possible data-integrity incident.

sections.heading: Unsaved form entries lost after a timeout
sections.text: Form pages do not save automatically. If the session ends while a page is open, unsaved entries are discarded and must be entered again. Saving each page before leaving it prevents loss.

steps.text: Share this article section so the user knows form pages must be saved before the session ends.

information_needed.prompt: The date and time of the failed attempt.
